h: Oral Torah Brings Good Forth From the Mixture

p: In the holy Zohar further on (III 42b):
"Rabbi Yose opened with the verse that follows:
גְּמָלַתְהוּ טוֹב וְלֹא רָע וְגוֹ׳ (מִשְׁלֵי לא, יב)
'She repays him good and not evil, etc.' (Mishlei 31:12)
she prepares good for the world,
and for the children of the palace;
'And the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil.'"
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
based on what is written in the holy Zohar
is the very cup of blessing,
what is 'the mountain of the House of Hashem'?
'And the end of days shall be
(what is written in the books, the Name,
is a scribal error that makes no sense,
and so it is in the new printing,
and so the Karnei Or wrote)
That is, since "the end of days"
and "the mountain of the House of Hashem"
which is the tree of good and evil;
and the verse comes to clarify
and it brings out 'the mountain of the House of Hashem'
this is good and not evil."
that the trait of Malchus comprises the whole tree,
the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil;
and it is as it says (Mishlei 5:5):
that is, it has kelipas nogah
And concerning kelipas nogah it is stated
(זֹהַר חָדָשׁ יִתְרוֹ ד״ו לח סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
(Zohar Chadash, Yisro, 38, end of amud a):
for there is none among all the kingdoms
that are close to the path of faith
from the understanding of the heart,
and there are in them fitting traits
but they are the root of heresy,
and there, in the kingdom of Greece,
and there is none among all the kings
"'And darkness' — this is the kingdom of Greece,
which darkened the eyes of Yisrael
'Write on the horn of the ox
that you have no portion in the God of Israel.'"
Now regarding the Tree of Life
it is stated in Tanna Devei Eliyahu
"And 'Tree of Life' means nothing but Torah";
and so it is written in the holy Zohar
אֵין עֵץ אֶלָּא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
"'Tree' means nothing but HaKadosh Baruch Hu";
which is from the side of the Tree of Life.
we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil:
fit and unfit, impure and pure
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר חֵלֶק א כז, ב)
the Written Torah would have sufficed,
the five books of the Torah
And this is what it says: "gemalashu"
the union of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah.
which receives from the Written Torah,
like the moon that receives from the sun.
to clarify in "the end of days":
"the mountain of the House of Hashem"
the holiness of Avraham, who called it a mountain,
and Yaakov, who called it a house
that is, that Torah she'b'al peh
will be only from the side of good,
and it too will be the Tree of Life.
And this is what it says in the holy Zohar:
that is, for the whole world,
and for the children of the palace":
the palace is the Beis HaMikdash,
from where Torah goes forth to all Yisrael
and in the Heichal is the Menorah,
which alludes to Torah she'b'al peh,
who engage in Torah she'b'al peh.
that it will be only on the side of good.
